basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a 28-year-old rhythm game enthusiast currently living in Tampa, Florida. By day, I work as a software developer, and by night, you'll find me battling it out in games like Arcaea and catching up on my favorite MTV shows like Siesta Key. I first got hooked on rhythm games during college and have been playing on and off ever since. I love connecting with fellow gamers and sharing tips and tricks. When I'm not gaming, I'm usually watching legal dramas or reliving my childhood days on Club Penguin. I'm currently single and spend most of my online hours in the evenings and on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Computer Science from the University of Florida, which has fueled my passion for technology and gaming. My love for rhythm games started as a hobby and turned into a way to unwind after long coding sessions. I often keep up with the latest gaming news and trends through various online communities.
